steps.title: Getting started
steps.text: Teleport to Falador.
Go to the White Knights' Castle, and head up to the 2nd floor[UK]3rd floor[US] of the western tower.
Talk to Sir Amik Varze.
[Accept Quest]

steps.title: The puzzles
steps.text: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien without any items equipped or in the inventory. He can be found in the Falador Park.
Optionally, sit on the bench next to Sir Tiffy Cashien to complete the achievement: Tiffy Time.

steps.title: Lady Table
steps.text:
In this room there will be eleven statues when there should be twelve. The goal is to study the statues then, when the twelfth one is returned, pick the one that was originally missing.
  • Easy method: look for the colour (bronze, silver, gold) of statue that only has 3 statues instead of 4, then note which weapon of that colour is missing out of the 4 possibilities (sword, halberd, great axe, or mace.)
  • Alternative method: the moment it shows 12 statues, take a screenshot. Then open the screenshot and compare which was missing and click it.
Find the statue that wasn't there originally and touch it.

steps.title: Sir Kuam Ferentse/Sir Leye
steps.text:
As a female character, kill Sir Leye.
  • If you have not visited the Makeover Mage before starting the quest, you can change your gender via the Customisation interface, under the Appearance tab.

steps.title: Sir Spishyus
steps.text: In this room, the chicken, grain, and the fox must all be transported to the other side of the bridge in a specific order.
Take the chicken across and put it down. In order to put down an object, open your equipment panel and click on the equipped object.
Take the fox across and put it down. Grab the chicken and return back.
Drop the chicken and take the Grain across.
Drop the grain and return back.
Take the chicken across and drop it.

steps.title: Miss Cheevers - Collect items
steps.text: Search the most south-western bookshelf for a knife.
Search all four of the most southern shelves with vials, take all of them.
Search the north-eastern middle-sized crate next to the chest for a tin.
Search the four northern shelves for the remaining vials, take all of them.
Pick up the metal spade on the table.

steps.title: First door
steps.text: Use the metal spade on the bunsen burner in the room.
Use the metal spade on the door.
Use cupric sulphate on the door.
Use a vial of liquid on the door.
Pull on the spade to open the door.

steps.title: Second door
steps.text: Use the gypsum on the tin.
Use a vial of liquid on the tin.
Use the tin on the key chained to the south-western wall.
Use the cupric ore powder on the tin.
Use the tin ore powder on the tin.
Heat the tin on the bunsen burner.
Use a  knife, bronze wire, or chisel on the tin.
Unlock the door with the bronze key.

steps.title: Sir Ren Itchood
steps.text: Talk to Sir Ren Itchood.
The first letter of each line he says is the answer to the door's lock.
Possible combinations are: BITE, FISH, LAST, MEAT, RAIN, or TIME.

steps.title: Ms. Hynn Terprett
steps.text: Talk to Ms. Hynn Terprett.

She will give you a riddle.

RiddleAnswer
If you were sentenced to death, what would you rather choose, thrown into a lake of acid, burned over a fire, fed to wolves that haven't eaten in 30 days or being thrown off a castle turret?Being fed to the wolves.
I dropped four identical stones, into four identical buckets, each containing an identical amount of water. The first bucket was at 32 degrees Fahrenheit, the second was at 33 degrees, the third was at 34 and the fourth was at 35 degrees. Which bucket's stone dropped to the bottom of the bucket last?The First Bucket.
A father is 4 times as old as his daughter. In 20 years he will be 2 times as old. How old is the daughter?10
I estimate there to be one million inhabitants in the world of Gielinor; creatures and people both. What number would you get if you multiply the number of fingers on everything's left hand, to the nearest million?0
The number of false statements here is one. The number of false statements here is two. The number of false statements here is three. The number of false statements here is four. How many false statements are there?There are 3 false statements.

steps.title: Sir Tinley
steps.text: After you talk to him, do not move, stand there and do nothing until he talks again. Do not take the hourglass.
After all the puzzles are done, quest complete!
